name: Maid Neko-san wa Ikaga Desu ka? ~Kikaijikake no Koi Monogatari~
original_name: メイドねこさんはいかがですか？～機械じかけの恋物語～
source:
One day during college 's summer vacation main character receives a huge baggage sent from his father. Inside is a a humanoid robot Ren with cat ears and a tail. It turns out she is constructed by hero's father and is sent for testing during 40 days. Despite being produced to handle maid duties, Ren has a lot of failures. But hero gets attached to her anyway.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大学暑假的某天，主人公收到了父亲寄来的巨大包裹。里面是一只长着猫耳和尾巴的人形机器人莲。原来她是主人公的父亲制造的，被送来进行为期40天的测试。尽管被设计来执行女仆职责，莲却故障频出。但主人公还是渐渐对她产生了感情。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
